issue.title: Retire completion_managed_install_recipe
issue.description: Deploy chezmoi completion as an apply-time installer recipe instead of frozen generated scripts.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Supported managed deployments have migrated to local stamps and no review or rollout depends on the snapshot exporter.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: completion deploy-chezmoi writes the legacy frozen generated scripts and chezmoi-owned stamp snapshots.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: completion deploy-chezmoi writes an apply-time chezmoi recipe that migrates legacy managed snapshots and regenerates completions from the installed SASE CLI.
